tree: What is sales pipeline management software?
Sales pipeline management software shows every open deal by stage, so your team can see what needs to happen next and move each opportunity forward.
Deals live in spreadsheets and inboxes, so nobody knows what stage they are in.
Every deal sits in one pipeline with a stage, an owner and a next step.
Deals move through stages like these.
From first contact to closed deal.
A clear, structured pipeline helps your team stay aligned and move opportunities forward.
See all deal details, customer information, tasks, notes and activity history in one place.
Keep track of what needs attention.
Easily see the status and next steps for every opportunity.
An overview of your current opportunities.
Set rules, automate assignments and maintain a consistent sales process.
Whether you run a local business, a service company or a growing sales team, Noxtill's pipeline helps you stay organized.
The bridge from lead to customer.
